# 行舟 · 个人行动与生活系统 v1.3.0

这一版本回答一个很实际的问题：**「这天我到底还要做多久？」** 执行切片日历和「本周」现在会同时给出当天还没做完的时长，让「已经提前做完的那一天」不再看起来像排满的一天；同时补齐了视图状态恢复、早晨第一动作提示和层级配色。

## 主要更新

- 执行切片日历与「本周」新增「待做」时长：当天状态仍为「已安排」（尚未完成）的切片时长合计。当天承诺的事全部做完或提前做完时，显示绿色「待做 0 分」并把整格标绿——一眼就能看出这天已经空出来、可以再安排其他事务；旁边保留「共 X 分 · N 片」（已安排＋已完成）作对照，两个数字一对上就不会把「待做」误读成空闲时间。
- 执行切片日历头部新增一行汇总与口径图例：今天起的待做合计、总量合计、已清空的整天数，并写明「待做＝当天已安排但还没完成的切片时长」。
- 日期格子按容器宽度自动收敛写法：宽格子「待做 240 分」，中等宽度去掉数字两侧空格「待做240分」，最窄（约 41px）时主行让出「分」、单位留在「共240分」那一行。任何宽度都不会只剩一个裸数字，也不会被省略号截断。
- 过去日期只显示「共 X 分 · N 片」：那天的「待做」已经没有意义，未完成的切片仍由红点、红边与「未完成」表示。
- 「本周」页签的日期行改成三个固定槽位：左侧「周X＋日期」、中间固定给「今天」（其它日期留空）、右侧「待做」chip 并始终贴右，不再出现「今天在右、chip 在中间」的跳位；列宽不足时 chip 省略「分」，窗口拉宽后自动恢复。
- 重新打开行舟会恢复上次离开「项目与事务」时的视图状态：页签、筛选、层级展开、选中事务与滚动位置；上次选中项已完成或不可见时，按「今日未完成切片最多（并列取树序第一）→ 树序第一个可见事务」确定性回落，关闭页签再打开也能恢复到刚点选的事务。
- 生活节律早晨「今日安排」新增只读提示：前一天 21:00 复盘写下的「明天开始工作时的第一个动作」会在次日早晨自动显示；不可编辑，前一天未填写时不显示。
- 层级浏览配色重塑：类型徽章用沉稳的莫兰迪低饱和色板，状态与切片指示用高饱和夏日色板，并统一为「方片小圆角＋彩色描边＋左侧 3px 彩条」，类型与状态不再混淆。
- 生活节律顶部工具栏改为左对齐，减少大屏下的切换移动距离；事务详情「执行切片」卡片压缩纵向占用，并在「目标切片数」后标明 366 片上限。

## 修复与体验改进

- 移除执行切片日历格子与「本周」待做 chip 的鼠标悬浮提示（读屏所用的无障碍说明保留）。
- 删除「本事务 N 片 · 完成 M」这行永远不会出现的冗余文案：同一事务同一天只允许一个切片，安排与移动都会拦截。
- 未设置预计时长的切片显示「待做 未估时」，部分估时时显示「待做 ≥X 分」，不再把未知时长混进分钟数。

## 升级说明

现有工作项、执行切片、生活节律、Checklist 与营养数据均兼容，无需手动迁移。本次没有改动既有数据结构；视图状态会写入插件私有的 `ui-state.json`（首次保存时自动创建）。

## 下载

请下载本 Release 附件中的 `package.zip`。不要使用 GitHub 自动生成的 Source code 压缩包作为思源插件包。

完整记录见 [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/Yong2Sheng/siyuan-plugin-xingzhou/blob/v1.3.0/CHANGELOG.md)。

# Xingzhou · Personal Action & Life System v1.3.0

This release answers a very practical question: **how much of this day is still left to do?** The execution slice calendar and Week now show the outstanding duration for each day, so a day whose committed work was finished early no longer looks like a full day. It also completes view-state restore, the morning first-action hint, and the hierarchy color rework.

## Highlights

- The execution slice calendar and Week now show a "to do" duration: the total length of slices still scheduled (not yet finished) on that day. When everything committed for a day is done or finished early, the cell shows a green "To do 0 min" and turns green, making it obvious the day is free for other transactions. The original "Total X min · N slices" (scheduled + completed) stays beside it, so reading the two together rules out mistaking "to do" for free capacity.
- The calendar header gained a summary row and a wording legend: outstanding total from today, committed total, and how many whole days are cleared, explaining that "to do = slices scheduled for that day that are not finished yet".
- Day cells adapt their wording to the available width: a wide cell reads "To do 240 min", a medium one drops the spaces around the number ("To do 240min"), and the narrowest (~41px) moves the unit to the "Total 240min" line. No width leaves a bare number, and nothing is clipped with an ellipsis.
- Past dates show only "Total X min · N slices": pending work no longer means anything there, and missed slices are still shown by the red dot, red border and "missed" wording.
- The Week date row is now three fixed slots: weekday + date on the left, a slot reserved for "Today" in the middle, and the "To do" chip always flush right, so the chip no longer jumps between middle and right. Narrow columns drop "min" from the chip and restore it when the window widens.
- Reopening Xingzhou restores the previous Projects & Tasks view state (page, filters, hierarchy expansion, selected transaction, and scroll position). If the previous selection is completed or hidden it falls back deterministically to the transaction with the most unfinished slices today (ties by tree order), otherwise to the first visible transaction. Closing the tab and reopening it returns to the transaction you had just selected.
- Life Rhythm's morning Today Plan shows a read-only hint with the "first action when work starts tomorrow" written in the previous evening's 21:00 review. It is not editable and stays hidden when the previous evening left it empty.
- Reshaped hierarchy colors: type badges use a calm Morandi palette while status and slice indicators use a vivid summer palette, all as square chips with a colored outline and a 3px left color bar, so type and status can no longer be confused.
- The Life Rhythm toolbar is now left-aligned to reduce pointer travel on wide screens, and the execution slice card is more compact with the 366-slice cap noted on the target-count field.

## Fixes and refinements

- Removed the hover tooltips from execution slice day cells and the week-board "to do" chip; the screen-reader labels keep the full wording.
- Deleted the "this transaction: N slices · M done" line that could never appear, since a transaction may hold only one slice per day, enforced when scheduling and moving.
- Slices without an estimate now read "To do unestimated" and partially estimated days read "To do ≥X min", so unknown durations no longer blend into the minute totals.

## Upgrade notes

Existing work items, execution slices, Life Rhythm records, Checklist state, and nutrition data remain compatible with no manual migration. No existing data structure changed; the view state is written to the plugin's private `ui-state.json`, created automatically on first save.

## Download

Download the attached `package.zip`. Do not use GitHub's automatically generated source-code archives as the SiYuan plugin package.
